edit.description: the outcome union gains the fate of a span the wave was walled before carrying, and the per-kind roster in its doc names it beside `dropped-work`
the fold records that span's base/head pair for the leg that will not carry it, without contributing a row to the per-pick slice `mergeAttempt` takes
the walled leg's fold is the one that names the uncarried fate
the walled wave's uncarried span row, beside the wave-refusal block

summary: A wave walled mid-merge folds an already-committed attempt's facts but records no merge outcome, so the base/head pair the artifact makes the recovery handle never reaches it

per.section: The tick verdict — one facts artifact

acceptance: an attempt whose agent committed and whose slot settled after the wave was walled reaches the verdict with a merge outcome of its own — the base/head pair naming its span, distinct from the kinds that reached cherry-pick — so that span is re-cherry-pickable from the verdict alone rather than found by hand on the worktree branch the refusal left standing
tests: a wave walled before an attempt was carried records that attempt's span with its base and head shas
notes: Off note THE-LEDGER-REFUSAL-VERDICT-NAMES-THE-SETTLED-WAVE (1). `foldAttemptFacts` (`src/waveMerge.ts:534`) pushes a row only for `tipMoved` and for `!committed` with a footprint; the walled leg folds at `src/waveTick.ts:420`. No spec enumerates the union (`spec/chain.md:642` is an ellipsis), no `harness/` consumer switches on it, and `isTickVerdict` (`:917`) does not read the member. Hazard: `outcomesStart` (`src/waveMerge.ts:457`) sits ahead of the fold; an empty slice returns early.
